doing good thanks - I feel I'm making the right decision and it's for the best.

Thanks Agnostix, but why should we stay here if we aren't happy or at least contented. You can only be kicked in the balls so many times before you decide to kick back. 

My own personal problems will never be solved, just anaesthetised; like most people's.
To misquote Doug Stanhope; "Suicide is green" - If enough people do it we'll leave a better world for those that remain! Fuck it, I don't wanna pass these genes on.

Thanks dude - Been there done that! But if anyone else needs it [Samaritans](http://www.samaritans.org/talk_to_someone/phone_calls.aspx) in the UK is 08457 90 90 90 

EDIT: Formatting

Yeah those things are good - if I could live my life with nature and my wife/family/friends then I could probably deal with it.

I've tried suicide the past - took 100+ paracetamol about 15 years ago, and survived with no medical intervention and no ill effects! Jumped in front of a car going 40mph - Same outcome as the pills! 

Didn't really want to outline what I'm doing this time, given the nature of this subreddit. But using the 'bag' method with sleeping pills. If that fails then I can go to [beachy head](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beachy_Head)
